title: Notch Apple 2.0.61 · Printer Status: sign in without a password
notes:
**Printer Status**
- 🔑 **Sign in to Bambu without a password.** If you use Google, Apple or Facebook to sign in to Bambu, enter the same email in Printer Status and press **Email me a code instead**: Bambu emails a six-digit code and that is all you need. Like the rest of the account sign-in, this is based on what the community has documented and has been tested against a simulated Bambu, not a live account, so please tell us if it does not work for you (LAN Mode always does).

Windows 1.63.0 BETA has the same option.

Install: download the DMG below and drag Notch Apple to Applications, or `brew upgrade --cask notch-apple`.

windows.notes:
Notch.apple for Windows 1.62.0

- Printer Status: sign in with your Bambu account to watch printers without LAN Mode (the printer keeps its cloud features). The password goes only to Bambu and is never saved; signing out deletes the saved token.
- Tested against a simulated Bambu, not a live account: if it does not work for you, LAN Mode still does.

The installer is still named "Notch.apple".
